
## FastQ Screen Contamination Screening

FastQ Screen aligns sampled reads to a panel of reference genomes to assess species composition and potential contamination. Unique and multiple-species alignment categories help distinguish target-specific sequences from shared regions. Interpret fractions against the reference panel and expected library origin [@wingett2018fastq]. 

```{python}
#| label: fastq-screen-pair
#| output: asis
from omics.rna.analysis.qc_vis import visualize_fastq_screen_pair
visualize_fastq_screen_pair(input_files['fastq_screen_r1_dir'], input_files['fastq_screen_r2_dir'])
display_result_ai('rna.qc.screen__R1')
display_result_ai('rna.qc.screen__R2')
```
